caption:
Google just changed how it verifies your business.

Postcards are gone for most listings. Google now requires a short, unedited video walkthrough instead, part of a verification overhaul reported since early July.

Skip it or fail the resubmission, and Google can suspend the profile. No map pack ranking, no reviews showing, no way for a customer to find you on Search or Maps until it's resolved.

What to film: your street signage, your address matching your profile exactly, and proof you operate there. One continuous take, a couple minutes, no edits.

Check your verification status this week. A suspended profile costs you visibility Google won't restore until you fix it.
